user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in ChatGPT search results
user_agents.scope: Crawls sites to surface in ChatGPT search features; opted-out sites won't appear in search answers

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety of ad landing pages submitted to ChatGPT
user_agents.scope: Visits only pages submitted as ads to validate compliance and determine ad relevance

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Training generative AI foundation models; improve model usefulness and safety
user_agents.scope: Crawls content for potential use in training generative AI foundation models

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: User-triggered actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs
user_agents.scope: Visits pages when users ask ChatGPT questions or interact with GPT Actions; not automatic crawling
user_agents.opt_out: robots.txt rules may not apply; user-triggered fetches not covered by robots.txt

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content for AI model training and development
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for training data collection
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: ClaudeBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt; also supports Crawl-delay: parameter

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content in response to user queries to Claude
user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetch for live responses to Claude user requests
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Claude-User / Disallow: / in robots.txt file

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web to improve search result quality and relevance for users
user_agents.scope: Web crawl for search indexing and optimization
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Claude-SearchBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt file

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Building Google Search indexes, Google Images, Google Video, Google News, Discover
user_agents.scope: General web crawl from IP ranges in common-crawlers.json

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawling images for Google Images, Discover, Google Video, Google Search image features
user_agents.scope: Image-specific crawling for image URLs and favicons

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawling videos for video-related Google Search features
user_agents.scope: Video-specific crawling for video content

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawling content for Google News product and news.google.com
user_agents.scope: News-specific crawling using various Googlebot user agent strings

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawling product information for Google Shopping surfaces
user_agents.scope: E-commerce crawling for Shopping tab and Google Shopping

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Testing and inspection for Search Console tools and Rich Result Test
user_agents.scope: On-demand inspection for Search Console testing tools

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawling for various product teams' publicly accessible content
user_agents.scope: Internal R&D crawls and one-off crawls across products

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Generic image crawling optimized for publicly accessible image URLs
user_agents.scope: Image URL fetching for various internal Google products

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Generic video crawling optimized for publicly accessible video URLs
user_agents.scope: Video URL fetching for various internal Google products

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawling for building Vertex AI Agents as requested by site owners
user_agents.scope: Site owner-requested crawls for Vertex AI Agent training

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Training future Gemini models and grounding Gemini Apps with search content
user_agents.scope: Content used for Gemini model training and search result grounding

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface and link websites in search results on Perplexity
user_agents.scope: Search result indexing; not used for AI training data collection

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Support user actions within Perplexity to fetch pages for accurate answers
user_agents.scope: User-triggered requests to visit web pages; not for crawling or AI training
user_agents.opt_out: Generally ignores robots.txt as it's user-requested, but sites can block via Perplexity-User in robots.txt

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology integrated into Spotlight, Siri, and Safari
user_agents.scope: General web crawl to enable search discovery across Apple ecosystem
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt to prevent crawling; content remains available for Spotlight/Siri if Applebot-Extended is allowed

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Determines content usage for training Apple foundation models powering generative AI features
user_agents.scope: Does not crawl webpages; evaluates already-crawled Applebot data for AI training eligibility
user_agents.opt_out: Add 'User-agent: Applebot-Extended / Disallow: /' in robots.txt to opt-out of generative AI training

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts
user_agents.scope: Podcast-specific URLs only; does not follow robots.txt as not a general search crawler
user_agents.opt_out: iTMS does not follow robots.txt directives

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content shared on Meta's family of apps (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger) to gather title, description, thumbnail
user_agents.scope: App or website content shared on Meta platforms; may bypass robots.txt for security checks
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: facebookexternalhit / Disallow: / in robots.txt; may bypass for security/integrity checks

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Improve Meta AI search result quality by analyzing online content for relevance and accuracy
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for Meta AI search indexing and citation

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawl web for improving advertising and business-related products and services
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for ads and business products

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Train foundation AI models and improve products by indexing content directly
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for AI model training and product improvement

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetch individual links at user request to support agentic AI capabilities and help AI navigate websites
user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetches for completing tasks; may bypass robots.txt
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: meta-externalfetcher / Disallow: / in robots.txt; may bypass for user-requested fetches

user_agents.name: Bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Search index crawling for Bing search results
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for search engine indexing

user_agents.name: BingPreview
user_agents.purpose: Preview generation for Bing search results
user_agents.scope: Fetches content for generating search result previews

user_agents.name: Adidxbot
user_agents.purpose: Bing Ads index crawling for advertising
user_agents.scope: Crawls web for Bing Ads indexing

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve Amazon products and services and train Amazon AI models
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for product improvement and AI model training
user_agents.opt_out: User-Agent: Amazonbot / Disallow: / in robots.txt file

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences in Amazon products and services
user_agents.scope: Crawl for search indexing in Alexa, Rufus; excludes generative AI training
user_agents.opt_out: User-Agent: Amzn-SearchBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt file

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Support user-triggered actions for real-time information fetching
user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetches for live information in response to Alexa queries
user_agents.opt_out: User-Agent: Amzn-User / Disallow: / in robots.txt file

user_agents.name: CCBot/2.0
user_agents.purpose: Web crawling for Common Crawl dataset creation
user_agents.scope: General web crawl to build Internet snapshot for research and analysis
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: CCBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt file

user_agents.name: CCBot/1.0
user_agents.purpose: Web crawling for Common Crawl dataset creation (older version)
user_agents.scope: General web crawl to build Internet snapshot for research and analysis
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: CCBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt file
